data.what_it_does: Triangulates 2D and multi-dimensional polygons with support for holes and Steiner points. It ports the Mapbox earcut algorithm to Dart for high-performance geometric computations.
use_when: You need to render complex polygons in 2D graphics or games
You are working with geographic data or custom map polygons
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile UI with basic layout needs
strengths: Handles holes and twisted polygons efficiently
Supports raw coordinate arrays and Point objects
weaknesses: Triangulation correctness is not strictly mathematically guaranteed for all degenerate inputs, though it attempts practical results
